decisions.reason: Packet s0090 reads 廆懼，首服, but CText Jinshu 載記第八 has 燾懼，首服 after Hui threatens nephew 燾; parallel editions likewise make Tao submit. Idiomatic "Bi" invents Cui Bi, and "Tao groveled in terror" restores the correct subject.
Same corrupt packet 廆懼; CText and parallel witnesses read 燾懼，首服, so the literal must name Tao, not Bi, as the one who submitted under threat.
惠皇之末 names Western Jin Emperor Hui (惠皇), not Murong Hui; bare "Hui's reign" in this Murong chapter misidentifies the referent, and "Late Emperor Hui" matches 惠皇之末.
Literal corrupts the title 《家令》 with broken backslash-escaped quotes and a stray trailing quote; restoring ordinary "Household Instructions" quotes fixes the field without changing sense.
